name: io.github.valewnrt/testa
description: Drive the iOS Simulator from an agent: read the screen, tap/type/swipe, replay flows in CI.

environmentVariables.name: TESTA_MCP_FULL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose all 40 tools instead of the 13-tool token-lean default.

environmentVariables.name: TESTA_UDID
environmentVariables.description: Target a specific simulator UDID instead of the booted one.

io.github.valewnrt/testa.note: The npm package is a thin launcher only. It requires the macOS-native `testa` binary on PATH: `brew tap valewnrt/testa https://github.com/valewnrt/testa && brew install valewnrt/testa/testa`. Once installed, `testa mcp` is itself a stdio MCP server and can be registered directly without npm.
